name: DVOL-expansion breakout momentum — ride the trend that follows an IV expansion
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (distinct from dvol-calm-regime-momentum, which requires LOW, falling crypto IV; this requires RISING IV crossing UP out of a calm band): a volatility regime change is itself tradeable. When Deribit DVOL (crypto-native 30d implied vol) crosses UP out of a quiet range, options dealers are repricing for a bigger move — and that vol expansion historically PRECEDES directional trends, not just chop, because the same flows that bid vol (leverage, new positioning, a catalyst) push price. The 'long gamma into an expansion' read: catch the IV breakout while it is still moderate (above a fitted expansion floor but below the panic ceiling where dvol-spike-iv-capitulation takes over), confirmed by price momentum so we ride expansion-WITH-trend, not expansion-into-a-crash. Entry: dvol crosses UP through a fitted expansion floor AND dvol below a fitted panic ceiling AND price in an uptrend. Exit: dvol crosses UP into the panic zone (hand off to the capitulation-reversion regime) OR price momentum rolls over; plus stop/TP/time. Disconfirmer 1: if an unconditional momentum long matches the deflated Sharpe, the IV-expansion trigger adds nothing. Disconfirmer 2: IV expansions are SYMMETRIC — they precede down-trends as often as up-trends; if the up-only confirmation (trend floor) is doing all the work, the dvol cross is noise. Disconfirmer 3: this partitions the dvol axis with dvol-calm (low) and dvol-spike (extreme) — the three must NOT be double-counted (same feature, different regime bands). Disconfirmer 4 (data depth): only ~148 DVOL points — low-confidence, paper-only until it deepens. Disconfirmer 5 (cost): must clear ~20bps round-trip net. tier0 crypto-native vol feature.
catalyst: DVOL crossing up out of a calm range — an IV expansion that precedes a directional trend
